BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian normal) — Maintain weight. Anti-cancer diet focus.
Surgery_Type: Modified Radical Mastectomy (MRM) + Axillary Lymph Node Dissection
Bone_Density_Concern: MODERATE — Post-menopausal bone loss. DEXA screening. Calcium + Vit D + weight-bearing exercise.
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: Dietary omega-3: mustard oil cooking + flaxseed + walnuts + fatty fish (if non-veg) 2x/week
Protein_Source_Note: Protein: eggs (2/day) + dal + paneer + curd + legumes + soya
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Individualized dietary counselling + ONS → EN if goals not met [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Calcium 600–1000 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) + Vitamin D 400–800 IU/day — endemic Vit D deficiency in India; Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; SARCOPENIA: Priority resistance training + leucine-rich protein (dal + paneer + dahi combination, 2–3g leucine/meal); TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [West India (Maharashtra/Gujarat/Rajasthan)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Active nutritional counselling + ONS if enriched Indian diet insufficient. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No energy restriction during treatment. No unproven diets — ketogenic, prolonged fasting, 'cancer-curing' diets widely promoted on Indian social media are NOT evidence-based. | 🏃 SURVIVOR [C5-1/C5-2]: Regular PA strongly recommended — 150–300 min/week. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet. ZERO alcohol. Maintain BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian cut-offs). Yoga beneficial for Indian survivors. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | 💪 SARCOPENIA (Indian): Low grip strength — sarcopenia prevalent in Indian BC patients even at normal/overweight BMI (sarcopenic obesity). Leucine-rich protein + resistance training essential. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Whole wheat paratha (1, stuffed with spinach/paneer, minimal ghee) + 1 cup low-fat curd + 1 small fruit + green tea || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Buttermilk (chaas, 200ml, home-made with mint + roasted jeera) — probiotic + calcium + hydration || 🍽 Lunch: 2 chapati + chana masala (chickpeas — fibre + plant protein) + baingan bharta + dahi + raw salad | Legumes reduce BC recurrence || 🕓 Snack: Prunes/anjeer (3) + 1 glass warm jeera-saunf water + flaxseed chutney (1 tsp); walk 15 min after; psyllium husk (isabgol, 1 tsp) in water if needed || 🌙 Dinner: Vegetable soup (mixed sabzi, 1.5 cups, homemade, low salt) + 2 multigrain roti + paneer/egg bhurji | Light + high protein || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm milk + 1 tsp ashwagandha powder (if not on chemo; consult oncologist) + pinch nutmeg | Adaptogen for stress + sleep || ✅ WEIGHT GAIN (Chemo/Hormone Therapy): Common in Indian BC patients on Tamoxifen/AI. Reduce maida, sugar, fried foods. Increase millets, vegetables, protein. 30 min brisk walk daily minimum. No crash diets during treatment. BMI target 18.5–22.9 post-treatment. || 💊 SUPPLEMENTS (Indian): Vit D 400–1000 IU/day (endemic deficiency in India), Calcium 600–1200 mg/day (especially AI patients), Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN), Omega-3 if vegetarian (algae-based DHA), Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignan source). || Regional: Jowar/bajra bhakri, dal-baati (baked, not fried), matki/chana ussal; reduce sugar in sabzi/dal (Gujarati); prefer bhakhri over fried snacks. || 💰 Low SES: Focus on cost-effective anti-cancer foods — seasonal vegetables, local millets, dals, eggs, sprouts. Government schemes: PM Poshan, NFSA for food access. Minimise food waste. Home-cooked preferred. || ⚠ OBESITY (Normal, Indian cut-off ≥25): Obesity significantly increases BC recurrence risk in Indian women. Post-treatment gradual weight loss (0.5 kg/week max). No energy restriction during active treatment. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet: dal-sabzi-millet base + minimal ghee/oil. Walk 45 min/day. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
